criteria.description: score.xlsx exists and is an openable native OOXML workbook.
The output preserves the Name/Score headers and all three source student rows in source order.
A single final Average row is present and its numeric value is the arithmetic mean of all source scores.
No source student is missing, duplicated, or changed, and no unrelated data rows are added.
The average is a native numeric editable cell with a readable number format and the sheet remains usable.
The solver-visible input matches the immutable OfficeBench source hash.
